headline: Massive fire engulfs saree warehouse in Faridpur
summary: Emergency services responded to the blaze in Faridpur, working to contain the fire and prevent further damage.
details: A massive fire broke out at a saree warehouse in Faridpur. Emergency services, including the Fire Service and Civil Defence, were immediately dispatched to the scene.
The blaze caused significant damage to the warehouse, with flames visible from outside the building. Firefighters are working to bring the situation under control.
The extent of the damage and the cause of the fire are yet to be determined. No immediate reports of casualties have been released.

headline: Factory owner arrested with huge quantity of medicine during raid in Cumilla
summary: A factory owner in Cumilla was arrested following a raid where authorities seized a significant quantity of medicine. The operation took place at the factory premises.
details: A factory in Cumilla was subjected to a raid by authorities. During the operation, a significant quantity of medicine was seized from the premises.
The owner of the factory was subsequently arrested in connection with the raid and the seized items.
